title: Vardas
transcriptLt: Labas! Koks tavo vardas? Mano vardas Jonas. O tavo? Mano vardas Lina.
transcriptEn: Hi! What is your name? My name is Jonas. And yours? My name is Lina.

questions.explanation: He says 'Mano vardas Jonas' (My name is Jonas).

title: Kiek tau metų?
transcriptLt: Labas! Kiek tau metų? Man yra dvidešimt metų. O tau? Man dvidešimt penkeri.
transcriptEn: Hi! How old are you? I am twenty years old. And you? I am twenty-five.

questions.questionText: How old is the first person?
questions.explanation: The first person says 'dvidešimt metų' (20 years old).

title: Iš kur tu esi?
transcriptLt: Labas! Iš kur tu esi? Aš esu iš Lietuvos. O tu? Aš esu iš Ispanijos.
transcriptEn: Hi! Where are you from? I am from Lithuania. And you? I am from Spain.

questions.questionText: Where is the first speaker from?
questions.explanation: The speaker says 'Aš esu iš Lietuvos' (I am from Lithuania).

title: Kaip sekasi?
transcriptLt: Labas! Kaip sekasi? Labai gerai, ačiū! O tau? Aš irgi gerai.
transcriptEn: Hi! How are you doing? Very good, thanks! And you? I am also good.

questions.explanation: The speaker replies 'Labai gerai, ačiū' (Very good, thanks).

title: Kur tu gyveni?
transcriptLt: Labas! Kur tu gyveni? Aš gyvenu Vilniuje. O tu? Aš gyvenu Kaune.
transcriptEn: Hi! Where do you live? I live in Vilnius. And you? I live in Kaunas.

questions.questionText: Where does the first speaker live?
questions.explanation: The speaker answers 'Aš gyvenu Vilniuje' (I live in Vilnius).

title: Atsisveikinimas
transcriptLt: Viso gero! Viso gero! Iki rytojaus! Iki!
transcriptEn: Goodbye! Goodbye! See you tomorrow! Bye!

questions.questionText: When will they see each other again?
questions.explanation: 'Iki rytojaus' means 'See you tomorrow'.

title: Kava ar arbata?
transcriptLt: Kava ar arbata? Kava, prašau. Su cukrumi? Ne, be cukraus.
transcriptEn: Coffee or tea? Coffee, please. With sugar? No, without sugar.

questions.questionText: What drink does the person choose?
questions.explanation: The person chooses 'Kava, prašau' (Coffee, please).

title: Ar kalbi angliškai?
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, ar kalbi angliškai? Taip, kalbu. Puiku, ačiū!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, do you speak English? Yes, I do. Great, thank you!

questions.explanation: The answer is 'Taip, kalbu' (Yes, I speak).

title: Taip ar ne?
transcriptLt: Ar nori vandens? Taip, prašau. Ar nori maisto? Ne, ačiū.
transcriptEn: Do you want water? Yes, please. Do you want food? No, thank you.

questions.explanation: The answer is 'Ne, ačiū' (No, thank you).

title: Šuo ar katė?
transcriptLt: Ar turi augintinį? Taip, turiu šunį. O tu? Aš turiu katę.
transcriptEn: Do you have a pet? Yes, I have a dog. And you? I have a cat.

questions.questionText: What pet does the first speaker have?
questions.explanation: The speaker says 'Turiu šunį' (I have a dog).

title: Kokia šiandien diena?
transcriptLt: Kokia šiandien diena? Šiandien yra pirmadienis. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: What day is today? Today is Monday. Thank you!

questions.explanation: 'Pirmadienis' means Monday.

title: Kiek dabar valandų?
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kiek dabar valandų? Dabar yra pirma valanda. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, what time is it? It is one o'clock now. Thank you!

questions.explanation: 'Pirma valanda' means one o'clock.

title: Kur yra stotelė?
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kur yra stotelė? Stotelė yra čia. Ačiū labai!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, where is the bus stop? The stop is here. Thank you very much!

questions.explanation: The answer given is 'Čia' (Here).

title: Mano brolis
transcriptLt: Ar turi brolį? Taip, turiu vieną brolį. O seserį? Ne, neturiu.
transcriptEn: Do you have a brother? Yes, I have one brother. And a sister? No, I don't.

questions.questionText: Does the person have a sister?
questions.explanation: The person says 'Ne, neturiu' (No, I don't).

title: Kiek kainuoja?
transcriptLt: Sveiki! Kiek kainuoja kava? Kava kainuoja du eurus. Prašau. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Hello! How much is the coffee? Coffee costs two euros. Here you go. Thank you!

questions.explanation: The price is 'du eurus' (two euros).

title: Šilta ar šalta?
transcriptLt: Ar šiandien šilta? Ne, šiandien labai šalta. Taip, tiesa.
transcriptEn: Is it warm today? No, today it is very cold. Yes, true.

questions.explanation: The speaker says 'labai šalta' (very cold).

title: Ką veiki?
transcriptLt: Labas! Ką veiki? Aš dirbu. O tu? Aš ilsiuosi.
transcriptEn: Hi! What are you doing? I am working. And you? I am resting.

questions.questionText: What is the second person doing?
questions.explanation: The second person says 'Aš ilsiuosi' (I am resting).

title: Ačiū ir prašom
transcriptLt: Ačiū labai už pagalbą! Nėra už ką! Gražios dienos! Tev taip pat!
transcriptEn: Thank you very much for the help! You're welcome! Have a nice day! You too!

questions.explanation: 'Nėra už ką' means 'You're welcome'.

title: Mėgstama spalva
transcriptLt: Kokia tavo mėgstama spalva? Mano mėgstama spalva yra mėlyna. O tavo? Raudona.
transcriptEn: What is your favorite color? My favorite color is blue. And yours? Red.

questions.questionText: What is the first speaker's favorite color?
questions.explanation: The speaker says 'mėlyna' (blue).

title: Ar nori arbatos?
transcriptLt: Labas! Ar nori arbatos? Taip, noriu. Ačiū! Prašom.
transcriptEn: Hi! Do you want tea? Yes, I do. Thank you! You're welcome.

questions.explanation: The guest answers 'Taip, noriu' (Yes, I want).

title: Kur yra tualetas?
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kur yra tualetas? Tualetas yra ten. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, where is the toilet? The toilet is over there. Thank you!

questions.explanation: The response is 'Ten' (Over there).

title: Labas rytas
transcriptLt: Labas rytas! Labas rytas! Gera diena šiandien. Taip, labai graži!
transcriptEn: Good morning! Good morning! Good day today. Yes, very beautiful!

questions.explanation: 'Labas rytas' means Good morning.

title: Labas vakaras
transcriptLt: Labas vakaras! Sveiki! Kaip laikotės? Gerai, ačiū.
transcriptEn: Good evening! Hello! How are you? Good, thank you.

questions.questionText: What time of day is this greeting used?
questions.explanation: 'Labas vakaras' means Good evening.

title: Mano vardas Tomas
transcriptLt: Sveiki, aš esu Tomas. Malonu! Aš esu Rūta. Malonu susipažinti!
transcriptEn: Hello, I am Tomas. Nice to meet you! I am Rūta. Nice to meet you!

questions.explanation: She says 'Aš esu Rūta' (I am Rūta).

title: Taip, aš studijuoju
transcriptLt: Ar tu dirbi? Ne, aš studijuoju. O tu? Aš dirbu.
transcriptEn: Do you work? No, I study. And you? I work.

questions.explanation: The person says 'Ne, aš studijuoju' (No, I study).

title: Skanus maistas
transcriptLt: Ar skanu? Taip, labai skanu! Ačiū. Prašom!
transcriptEn: Is it delicious? Yes, very delicious! Thank you. You're welcome!

questions.explanation: The speaker says 'Labai skanu!' (Very delicious!).

title: Ar turi automobilį?
transcriptLt: Ar turi automobilį? Ne, neturiu. Aš važiuoju autobusu. Supratau.
transcriptEn: Do you have a car? No, I don't. I ride the bus. I understand.

questions.explanation: The person says 'Aš važiuoju autobusu' (I ride the bus).

title: Koks tavo telefono numeris?
transcriptLt: Koks tavo telefono numeris? Mano numeris yra vienas du trys. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: What is your phone number? My number is one two three. Thank you!

questions.questionText: What digits are mentioned in the phone number?
questions.explanation: 'Vienas du trys' means 1 2 3.

title: Pagalba
transcriptLt: Ar gali man padėti? Taip, žinoma! Kuo galiu padėti?
transcriptEn: Can you help me? Yes, of course! How can I help?

questions.questionText: Does the person agree to help?
questions.explanation: The person replies 'Taip, žinoma!' (Yes, of course!).

title: Iki pasimatymo!
transcriptLt: Iki pasimatymo! Iki! Geros dienos! Tev taip pat!
transcriptEn: See you later! Bye! Have a good day! You too!

questions.explanation: 'Iki pasimatymo!' translates to 'See you later' or 'Goodbye'.
